name: SAINTOS V4 - 01 TESTED CEO COMMAND CENTER

parameters.content:
# SaintOS Mega Agent V4

Manual trigger tested end-to-end.

The production AI Agent nodes stay visible for portfolio architecture, while the tested demo path uses deterministic code so it passes without API keys.

## Inputs

Gmail, WhatsApp, Telegram, voice and portal intake.

## Tested Demo Path

Manual trigger uses code-based agent simulation. No external keys needed.

## AI Agent Architecture

Visible n8n AI Agent, model, memory and workflow tools for production connection.

## Managers

Active connected manager workflows.

## Safety

Memory, approval, audit and monitoring.

## Outputs

Drafts only. No live send.
